summary: Fixed note embedding to use title-only consistently. The retry path (cold-start fallback in /overlay/note) was using `${b.title} ${b.summary}` instead of `b.title`. Changed to `b.title` matching primary embed-on-write, /overlay/backfill-embeddings, and /overlay/reembed. Ran /overlay/reembed with force:true on the live daemon (233 notes re-embedded) and restarted daemon to pick up code fix, then re-ran reembed again (233 notes). All note vectors now consistently embed title-only.

subject: Embed title-only for notes (not title+summary) + re-backfill
description:
Change all 3 embed calls for notes in daemon.js from `embed(title + summary)` to `embed(title)` only. Notes are matched against short agent queries (~10 tokens); mean-pooling 246 tokens of implementation prose dilutes the embedding. Title is already the distilled, query-aligned text.

Files to change:
- daemon.js line ~2118: note creation path `b.vec = await embed(\`${b.title} ${b.summary}\`)`  → `embed(b.title)`
- daemon.js line ~2229: backfill path `embed(\`${n.title || ''} ${n.summary || ''}\`)` → `embed(n.title || '')`
- daemon.js line ~2257: retry/judge path (same pattern) → title-only

After the code change: hit `POST /overlay/backfill-embeddings` to re-embed all ~230 existing notes with the new scheme. Verify with a /search test that gate scores improve on known queries.

Test: query "resolveOwner task transcript" should score ≥ 0.65 (currently 0.591 with title+summary).
